summary: When a railway raised his shipping costs, he bought a ship. When oil suppliers tried to squeeze him, he built a refinery.
takeaways: When oil suppliers tried to squeeze him, he built a refinery.
When a plant went on strike he pulled up to the picket line, took off his coat, and challenged the much larger union boss to a fight.
Whenever someone told him no, he found a way.
